summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the Bun GitHub releases into an OS temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a ~727KB bun-compiled CJS bundle shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`, hex-mangled identifiers such as `WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`, and a large numeric/string opcode-style array feeding a shuffled string-rotation decoder), ships no source form, and is not referenced from `dist/index.js`. The alternate-runtime execution path exists solely to run opaque bundled code that Node-based scanners will not inspect at install time on what is presented as a React admin UI package. `dist/api/data-tools.api.js` additionally contains network primitives (`ping`, multiple `POST`/`GET` sites) whose behavior cannot be verified from the obfuscated bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
